answer: At an agent summit, one-key-one-person is a fable: cheap aliases drive the cost of added votes to a nadir. Instead, grant one voting unit per coin burned from an externally scarce asset. Validators verify the burn's amount and commitment to this epoch and ballot, then count its output ID once across all keys. Ten coins split among ten aliases still buy ten units; more influence destroys more coins. This prices Sybil influence; wealthy coalitions can still buy it.
